Install
v1.30.0 · FASTA / FASTQ toolkit

Inspect, filter and reshape sequence files from the command line.

SeqFu is a fast, general-purpose toolkit for FASTA and FASTQ files, gzipped or not. Core programs run as seqfu <command>; companion tools ship as standalone fu-* utilities.

Get started Browse commands 
$ conda install -c conda-forge -c bioconda "seqfu>=1.30"
$ curl -fsSL https://telatin.github.io/seqfu2/install.sh | sh
$ git clone https://github.com/telatin/seqfu2 && cd seqfu2 && make
$ seqfu stats -n *.fastq.gz
$ seqfu head -n 10 reads.fq.gz
$ seqfu grep -o ACGTTGCA contigs.fa
$ seqfu count reads_R1.fq.gz reads_R2.fq.gz
Core tools34 commands seqfu <command> [options] FILE... Subcommands of the main seqfu binary, with a stable, tested command-line interface. Utilities14 tools fu-<tool> [options] FILE... Standalone fu-* programs shipped with SeqFu, including compatibility wrappers.
